An Ordinance further to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 31st March, 2001]
F. No.2(I)/2001-Pub. dated
31-3-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Sales Tax (Second
Amendment) Ordinance, 2001,
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in the Sixth Schedule of Sales Tax Act, 1990

SALES TAX (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
SALES TAX (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XVII OF
2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Sales Tax Act, 1990
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 31st March, 2001]
F. No.2(I)/2001-Pub. dated
31-3-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of the Sixth
Schedule, Sales Tax Act, 1990.--In the Sales Tax Act, 1990, in the Sixth
Schedule, the following amendments shall be made:--
(a) "in Serial No. 17,
(i) in column (2), for the word
"Fertilizers", the words "Fertilizers excluding area
fertilizer" shall be substituted; and
(ii) in column (3), before the
word and figure "Chapter 31", the words "Respective headings
of" shall be inserted;
(b) in Serial No. 18, the entries
relating to thereto in columns (2) and (3) shall be omitted; and
(c) in Serial No.55, the entries
relating thereto in columns (2) and (3) shall be omitted".
